name: Quote Spotlight Carousel
description: Pastel-gradient testimonial spotlight: a wide rounded image with a circular avatar monogram overlapping its bottom edge, a big centered quote, name and role, and a dark dot-carousel pill. Prev/next and dots crossfade between testimonials with wrap-around.
interactions: spotlight carousel: prev/next and dots switch the active testimonial with wrap-around; the image + overlapping avatar and the quote/name/role crossfade (opacity .3s, content swapped after 220ms)
the active dot widens (8px -> 22px) and brightens to invert; others stay muted
media + stage + controls reveal on first view (IntersectionObserver, 600ms wpmn-qsc-up, staggered)
arrow hover fill at 120ms; focus-visible inset ring via --btn-bg-focused
prefers-reduced-motion: crossfade/transitions off, content swaps instantly, reveals render in place
